scenario.title: Carrier rejects shipment notices
scenario.initial_request: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

CL-01.statement: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

CL-02.statement: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

H-REQ-FRAME.statement: Shipment notices contain errors that cause carrier rejects; an AI agent can auto-fix and resubmit them.

H-CARRIER-RULE.statement: Carrier recently changed validation business rules, increasing rejects independent of notice quality.

H-HANDOFF-GAP.statement: Handoff H-1 from shipper to carrier lacks required payload data, causing carrier rejects.

interpretation_history.interpretation: Two of three rejected notices are due to missing location data (LOC_UNKNOWN) and one due to event ordering (EVENT_ORDER), indicating data quality issues in the handoff.

E-02.content: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder suggests the carrier system is unreliable (flaky) and recommends resubmitting all notices as a workaround.

U-U1.question: Could carrier rule changes (H-CARRIER-RULE) also contribute to rejects?
U-U1.decision_impact: Could require additional fixes beyond payload enrichment.
U-U1.resolution_path: Inspect carrier validation logs for recent rule changes and compare timing with reject spikes.
U-U1.safe_placeholder: Continue monitoring reject reasons while payload enrichment is deployed.

U-U2.question: Is the missing location data lost upstream (shipper) or during handoff transformation?
U-U2.decision_impact: Determines where to inject the missing data.
U-U2.resolution_path: Trace data flow from shipper system to handoff to identify where location data is omitted.
U-U2.safe_placeholder: Implement upstream validation at shipper side before handoff.

U-U3.question: Are EVENT_ORDER rejects caused by handoff timing or carrier processing delays?
U-U3.decision_impact: May need buffering or retry logic.
U-U3.resolution_path: Analyze timestamps of notices with EVENT_ORDER to see if delays occur before or after handoff.
U-U3.safe_placeholder: Introduce a buffer or retry mechanism for notices with EVENT_ORDER.

A-A1.statement: Missing payload data is the sole cause of LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER rejects.

A-A2.statement: Enriching handoff H-1 with missing data will resolve the rejects.

A-A3.statement: Handoff H-1 is the only handoff involved in the shipment notice flow.

SC-SC1.statement: Rejects due to LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER must drop to zero after intervention.
SC-SC1.validation_method: Compare reject-log.reason counts for LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER before and after payload enrichment.

SC-SC2.statement: Overall reject rate should be reduced by at least 80% within 4 weeks.
SC-SC2.validation_method: Calculate reject rate (rejected/total) from reject-log before and after intervention.

problem_definition.root_problem: Missing required payload data in handoff H-1 from shipper to carrier causes carrier to reject shipment notices due to LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER reasons.

trace.summary: Missing required payload data in handoff H-1 from shipper to carrier causes carrier to reject shipment notices due to LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER reasons.

structural_remedies.description: Update handoff H-1 specification to mandate location and event sequencing fields and add pre-send validation at the shipper, addressing hypothesis H-HANDOFF-GAP (supported by E-01).
structural_remedies.rationale: Can be done via configuration change within the remaining 225 minutes.; residual gap: Uncertainty about whether data loss occurs upstream (U-U2) remains; requires verification before release.

structural_remedies.description: Introduce a data enrichment middleware that augments handoff H-1 with missing location data from master references and reorders events before transmission to carrier, based on assumption A-A2 that enriching handoff resolves rejects.
structural_remedies.rationale: Middleware can be prototyped within the remaining time window.; residual gap: Depends on completeness and correctness of reference data; if reference data is inadequate, gap persists.

proposal.summary: Missing required payload data in handoff H-1 from shipper to carrier causes carrier to reject shipment notices due to LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER reasons [E-01]. The reject log shows two LOC_UNKNOWN and one EVENT_ORDER rejects, indicating data quality issues in handoff H-1 [E-01]; hypothesis H-HANDOFF-GAP is supported by this evidence. The release includes monitoring of reject rate via the reject-log data asset [DA-REJ] but does not include payload enrichment or specification updates. The DEFINE Gate resulted in CONDITIONAL_PASS with deferred items tracked as VOBs, and the semantic check found the scope does not address the root problem, leading to a release with known limitation. The release does not enrich handoff H-1 or update specification to fix missing location and event data; VOB-U-U2 remains open regarding whether the missing data is lost upstream or during transformation; only monitoring is in place.
key_points: Problem: Missing payload data in handoff H-1 causes LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER rejects [E-01].
Established: Reject log evidence shows data quality issues [E-01]; H-HANDOFF-GAP hypothesis supported.
Released: Monitoring reject rate via reject-log [DA-REJ]; no enrichment or spec update.
Decision: Conditional pass from DEFINE Gate with semantic scope gap → release with known limitation.
Limitations: No payload enrichment or spec fix; VOB-U-U2 open on upstream vs transformation loss; monitoring only.
limitations_explained: VOB-U-U2 open: missing location data origin unknown (upstream shipper or handoff transformation).
Release scope lacks actions to enrich handoff H-1 or update specification, so root cause not addressed.
